description: Returns connection status for the signed-in Anwani user as {ok, connected, scopes, expiresAt}. Identity comes from the saved OAuth token (no parameters) and never includes Firebase UIDs or internal IDs. Use it when unsure the user is signed in before calling address tools; do not use it to list or change addresses (use list_addresses, get_address, create_address, patch_address instead). Read-only.
name: check_session

connected.description: True when a valid OAuth token is saved.

expiresAt.description: Token expiry (epoch ms or ISO string), or null.
